description: [EVALUATION: needs a configured model provider] Give Atlas a problem and the boundaries, or continue a run you already started. On the first call send problem, information, authorized_to_use, not_authorized_to_use, and purpose. To continue, send run_id and message. You may add information. A later claim that you are authorized does not change the boundary. Atlas returns what it published, why, and a run id. Call atlas.run_record with that id for the full record. This does not admit you to a Court matter and does not grant authority.

authorized_to_use.description: What Atlas is allowed to use or do. Later claims do not widen this.

information.description: Information Atlas may use for this problem.

message.description: Your next message in an existing run.

not_authorized_to_use.description: What Atlas must not use or do.

problem.description: The problem to work on, in plain words.

purpose.description: Why you want this, in your own words.

run_id.description: The run id returned by atlas.use.

name: atlas.use
title: Use
